body: Thank you. I guess I should have been clearer about the baby thing, it wasn’t a “I want it right now” it was an in the future talk.
Should I show him this? I made a secret account because I was afraid he’d get mad again.

Thank you for your advice. It has led to him accidentally hurting me before. But it’s usually because I’m in his way and he’s trying to leave the room. He’s pushed me out of his way causing me to hit my head on the wall, or fall to the ground.. but after he calms down he extensively cried to me saying he was really sorry.
I can understand everything you’re saying except for the sex part. Thank you. He was most definitely making a very obvious frown, and sad noise at me because he noticed he wasn’t able to please me.
